content.short: Connext Subgraph enables efficient querying of Connext protocol data on-chain.
content.description: Connext Subgraph indexes data generated by the Connext network and makes it accessible via a standardized GraphQL API endpoint. Developers can query bridge transactions, transaction statuses, user activity, and other cross-chain transfer data from the Connext network. Designed for indexing cross-chain transfers, Connext Subgraph maintains mainnet subgraphs for Ethereum, Optimism, Arbitrum, Polygon, Avalanche, and Base, providing a centralized on-chain information source across these networks to support applications, analytics, and dashboards that rely on cross-chain data.
